text:
Iris: dropped a new compact rollout row mock — intent: make canaries and A/B variants scannable at a glance without expanding each row. figma: https://figma.redwood/rows
Noah: nice. can we keep rows one line tall and put actions in an overflow menu to avoid clutter?
Iris: yes, overflow menu + a small chevron for details. primary quick action should open a confirm flyout, not perform immediately.
Jules: accessibility: overflow must be keyboard reachable and announceable. use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. focus should move into the flyout on open.
Pat: microcopy: prefer "Restore" for user-facing flows, but include "action: rollback" in technical details so logs stay consistent.
Noah: for canary chips show percent inline: "canary · 15%". chips must be focusable and have aria-describedby linking to a tooltip with allocation controls shortcut.
Jules: tooltips need role="tooltip" and be reachable via keyboard. also ensure color isn't the only status cue — add icons/text.
Iris: confirmation modal copy: header "Restore deployment", body "Switch traffic and config to v87. In-flight requests may be affected. This will not delete versions.", primary "Restore now", secondary "Cancel", small helper "Technical action: rollback".
Pat: safety: show a cancellable countdown (20s) with a visible progress bar and a "Force now" option. if forced, call API with force=true.
Noah: consider an undo snackbar for 5 minutes with 'Undo' button. ops can decide if quick-undo is enabled per env.
Iris: diff preview: show a one-line human summary like "LOG_LEVEL: INFO → DEBUG; workers: 8 → 12" with expand to full JSON.
Jules: final accessibility checklist: aria-live for success, trap focus in modals, return focus to row after action, reduced-motion respect.
ops-bot: Deploy v87 -> production succeeded at 2025-06-03T12:02:10Z :rocket:
Iris: thanks — I'll update the figma and post updates before tomorrow's design review. :sparkles:
